semanticNotes: Reading and listening quoted evidence is checked against the frozen source verbatim. Grammar evidence is separately identified as a rule or completed example; it is not falsely required or claimed to be a passage quote.
The quantity-word explanations correctly qualify the some/any rule and the location/sequencing explanations follow the meaning specified by each grammar prompt.
Week-12 grammar overlaps remain retrieval consolidation of the same past-tense targets, not proof of two additional new grammar areas.
The short explicit-fact questions and 80-word writing prompts are A2-oriented training estimates; no IELTS score or learner calibration is inferred.
